slides.headline: Resident Evil Requiem Takes 4 Golden Joysticks, Including GOTY

slides.stat_label: Requiem's Ultimate Game of the Year Vote Share
bullets: Resident Evil Requiem edged Phantom Blade Zero's 16%

GTA 6, out 19 Nov, wasn't on the shortlist

slides.stat_label: Capcom's Studio of the Year Vote Share

Resident Evil Requiem is ₹4,399 on Steam India
